Later Specimen.focus work, including FHIR-53384, revised the subject wording and added focus guidance for source-patient cases, but retained BiologicallyDerivedProduct as an allowed Specimen.subject target. OO Confluence minutes confirm the use case and persuasive vote; no direct Zulip discussion for the issue key was found.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the active current source already contains targetProfile value="http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/BiologicallyDerivedProduct" under Specimen.subject, satisfying the issue without contradiction from later context.
